result.stdout:
Bond Schema Compiler - Parses and validates Bond IDL files

Usage:
  bcc parse <file.bond> [options]
  bcc breaking <file.bond> --against <reference> [options]

Commands:
  parse       Parse and validate a Bond schema file
  breaking    Check for breaking changes against a reference schema
  format      Format a Bond schema file

Parse Options:
  -v, --verbose              Show detailed AST output
  --json                     Output AST as JSON (Bond schema format)
  --ignore-imports           Parse without resolving imports or types

Breaking Options:
  --against <reference>      Reference schema to compare against (file path or .git#branch=name)
  --error-format <format>    Output format: text, json (default: text)
  --ignore-imports           Compare without resolving imports or types

Format Options:
  --check                    Exit non-zero if formatting is needed

Examples:
  bbc parse schema.bond
  bbc breaking schema.bond --against schema_v1.bond
  bbc breaking schema.bond --against .git#branch=main --error-format=json
  bbc format schema.bond

Global Options:
  -h, --help                 Show this help message
